data.one_liner: Free, unofficial Google Translate API wrapper for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows translating strings and text using a free Google Translate interface. Supports language auto-detection and custom source/target language codes.
use_when: You need a quick translation tool for educational purposes
You want a free wrapper over Google Translate without official API credentials
avoid_when: You need a stable, production-ready translation API that won't break on website changes
You require official enterprise support for translations
strengths: Easy to use with string extension methods
Free and requires no API key
weaknesses: Based on crawling the Google Translate website and may break anytime

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides robust, official localization and internationalization support for Dart and Flutter.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers production-ready static localization management for Flutter apps.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type-safe internationalization for Flutter with build-time validation.
